references.text: The next verse continues the theme of the fire that must always burn on the altar and never be extinguished.
Describes how the priests are to add wood to the fire and arrange the pieces of the burnt offering on the altar.
Refers to the fat from the peace offerings that is to be burned on the altar, as mentioned in this verse.
The fire that came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar.
Describes the daily burnt offering morning and evening that was to be offered continuously.
The continual burnt offering that was to be offered every morning, in accordance with the priest's duty described here.
Under Nehemiah, wood for the altar was provided at set times, showing the continuation of this practice.
Ezekiel describes the hearth of the altar (Ariel) where the fire was to burn.
